title: BUILT CoLAB e AdDP concluem etapa de digitalização das suas infraestruturas de água
excerpt: BUILT CoLAB presented the results of the project to digitise Águas do Douro e Paiva’s infrastructures. This session, aimed at the AdDP team, was designed to share the work carried out during this partnership phase, the lessons learned and the impact of this process on the ongoing digitalisation strategy.
